purpose: Protect an RTF physical continuation line that begins with a year from being misclassified as a new Ovid strategy row.
authority: Normative Cochrane Ovid MEDLINE-to-PubMed Conversion Rules v20
reference_v20_v2_note: The current parser may interpret the physical continuation beginning '2020 publication...' as strategy row 2020. Normative v20 requires it to remain part of row 2.
